name: Beer Hat
special: Holds one drink, filled outside combat; in combat it can be drunk hands-free as a minor action.

name: Marine Tactical Helmet
special: Worn with a Marine Wetsuit: breathe underwater.

name: Spacesuit Helmet
special: Worn together with the Spacesuit Costume: breathe underwater and wherever the air is not breathable.

name: Marine Wetsuit
special: No cold-weather exposure from swimming in cold water.

name: Underarmor Suit
special: Re-roll 1d20 on one STR or PER test per scene.

name: Cleanroom Suit
special: Re-roll 1d20 on every END test while the hood is up and the mask on.

name: Hunter’s Pelt Outfit
special: Shadowed; counts as four Shadowed pieces (CRB p. 133).

name: Spacesuit Costume
special: Worn together with the Spacesuit Helmet: breathe underwater and wherever the air is not breathable.

name: Chinese Stealth Armor
special: Re-roll 1d20 on Sneak tests. Stealth field (Interact minor action): +2 difficulty to spot you and +2 Defense while invisible; attacking shuts it down until reactivated.

name: Diving Suit
special: Breathe underwater and in hostile atmospheres; immune to deep-water pressure damage and to cold from cold water.
